88.source: SpellItemEnchantment id 88 carries no Name_lang and is not referenced by any Enchant-effect (SpellEffect Effect 53/54) spell in any of the three regenerated client builds (2.5.6.69546 TBC Anniversary, 3.4.5.63697 WotLK, 4.4.2.60895 Cata) — verified empty across all three by inspecting the raw CSV export during the 2026-09 regeneration. Appears to be a deprecated pre-release placeholder row with no recoverable in-game name.

2566.value: Healing Power (+24 Healing and +8 Spell Damage)
2566.source: Every SpellEffect row (Effect 53/54) referencing SpellItemEnchantment id 2566 in the classic-tbc/wotlk/cata client dumps points to an internal QA/test spell (name prefixed "QAEnchant"), so no player-facing spell name is derivable from client data. The friendly label "Healing Power" is preserved from the pre-regeneration hand-verified lib/cla-constants.ts entry; the parenthetical stat text ("+24 Healing and +8 Spell Damage") is still wago-derived, reproduced verbatim from SpellItemEnchantment.Name_lang.
